_comment: QC thresholds for Ninapro DB6, derived from the data rather than chosen.
Produced by: py -3.11 -m reborn.data.qc_calibration data/ninapro_db6 --subjects s01 --channels 0 10
Calibrated on subject s01 (all 10 sessions); subject s02 was held out as a check.
The thresholds in reborn.sensing.emg_qc are absolute, and DB6 samples are of
order 1e-5 V, so the module defaults reject ~100% of this dataset for reasons
that have nothing to do with signal quality. See docs/research/phase-b-plan.md.
DB6 records 14 electrodes into a 16-column array; columns 8 and 9 are
identically zero in every file checked. The gate rejects a window when any
inspected channel fails, so leaving the padding in rejects everything.
The two-channel montage mirrors Reborn's own hardware rather than modelling
a 14-electrode forearm array the system does not have. Channel RMS across
the array spans a factor of ~40, so calibrating over all channels at once
produces thresholds that suit none of them.
reborn.sensing.corruption also takes absolute amplitudes sized for signals
of order 1. Injecting its defaults into DB6 applies a fault ~50000x the
signal, which every detector catches; the resulting detection rates are an
artefact of scale. These are severity 3.0 relative to the montage.

observed._comment: Measured with the above; these are the first real numbers from the pipeline.
notes: Thresholds derived on s01 transfer to the held-out s02 (0.10% rejection), so
they describe the dataset rather than one subject.
s01 session d04_t01 rejects 3.6%, an order of magnitude above its neighbours
(0.0-1.4%). That is a per-session signal-quality event, not noise in the
threshold, and it is a result worth reporting rather than smoothing away.
Fault detection at severity 3.0 on real windows: dropout 100%, clipping 100%,
The saturation injector overdrives by gain 10, which rarely reaches the rail
on real EMG, so 19% measures a weak injection rather than a weak detector.
noise_burst at 0% reproduces the designed division of labour: it is not the
deterministic layer's job, it is the advisory anomaly detector's. With the
unscaled defaults it read 100%, which had hidden that split entirely.
